gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: low-volatility 20-day high breakouts with volume confirmation may capture cleaner accumulation than raw 5-day continuation or gap-down reversal.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-018/022: VBB support variants were accepted as paper leads, but this run is not a VBB threshold retune; it uses a prior-high breakout structure.
2_history_check.exp-20260529-001: VWAP reclaim relative-strength scanner failed with aggregate EV -0.9151 and PnL -$11,068.78, plus late_strong/old_thin regressions and drawdown drift.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-010: Gap-down recovery was rejected despite positive aggregate because old_thin and late PnL regressed and drawdown worsened.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-014: Broad 5-day winner exhaustion cap was rejected because old_thin regressed, drawdown drift stayed high, and it underperformed the accepted ETF substitute.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard passes.

hypothesis: Broad liquid stocks making a low-volatility 20-day high breakout with volume confirmation may improve the default-off candidate pool without reusing recent 5-day winner or gap-recovery signals.
interpretation: The low-volatility 20-day high breakout candidate source did not clear Gate 4; do not promote or locally retune this OHLCV breakout family on the frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that low-volatility 20-day high breakouts are still a broad OHLCV momentum relabeling whose replacement value is not stable across the frozen three-window stack. Do not answer by sweeping nearby breakout, volume, volatility, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on these same windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially new evidence such as forward replacement-value rows, a real-time breadth persistence field, or a production-visible catalyst/flow provenance layer. Pure OHLCV threshold retunes should stay frozen.
